research_question: Does the original WSP137 active experiment chooser outperform the STRONGEST of original fixed32 AND independent random32 action acquisition on 16 unconditional future requests per novel synthetic world, including new conditional-switch relations, without knowing future query positions?
rationale: WSP139 beat only fixed and tested inputs selected conditional on both actions. Privileged WSP135 oracle random controls previously tied adaptive on unfamiliar worlds; without source-blind random comparator, acquisition gain is unproven. WSP140 already separately reserved for bit-parallel cost optimization (cannot duplicate).

source.zero_effect_relabel: 234000..234003 map to four known source laws
source.reject: all other seeds and all previous WSP117-140 source seeds, especially 230800,231800,232800,233800,234800 contiguous64 bands; reject before RNG, deny authentic CausalGym/MDP/DTR first-use
source.generator: 6bit Boolean hidden independent SHA256-seeded wiring role permutation and hidden AND/OR/XOR/XNOR pair gates; known arbitrary outer gate XOR p4/(p4 AND p5), unfamiliar MAJORITY(g1,g2,p4) XOR p5, new SWITCH (p4?g1:g2) XOR p5, off XOR cross pair products p0p2,p1p3,p0p4,p1p5,p4,p5. Source only reveals effect AFTER a paid distinct typed x.
source.public_before_action: all 64 typed input x=0..63 and opaque IDs; no future question x/score, true source seed, hidden law, operator or oracle allowed to policy
source.cost: 28 independent synthetic worlds x 3 policies x32 actual source effects = 2688 calls, 4 cold relabel views at zero calls

policies.active: EXACT pinned WSP137 ActivePolicy, first 4 original schedule then 28 source-blind disagreements among 17640 generic templates, all64 actions eligible, SHA256 candidate ranking and tie policy unchanged
policies.fixed: EXACT pinned WSP135 N.schedule original 32 action sequence, all64 eligible
policies.random: Source-blind deterministic random.Random(int.from_bytes(SHA256('WSP141|RANDOM32|'+str(public_law_id)),big)).sample(range(64),32), independent of source and future keys. Same generic learner after observations.
policies.frozen_readout: EXACT pinned WSP135 N.fit/N.predict once each 32 effects, identical 17640 supplied latent templates and confidence rules for all policies. For task utility, an input x already observed must return its paid factual y directly for ALL arms; count this SEEN, never new inference.
policies.controls: Independently implemented WSP137 SAME-INFORMATION symbolic factor control must tie numerical for all UNSEEN x (and direct factual recall for SEEN). Fully fitted WSP135 depth-6 CART gets same 32 per-policy observations + same seen direct recall; memo-only returns seen y else abstain, no-update abstains all. WSP136 full-grammar oracle stronger-prior reference on KNOWN/UNFAMILIAR only and never guides action.
policies.boundary: WSP137 chooser and WSP135 fit/readout source code remain UNCHANGED, no new architecture, learned primitive invention or native training claimed

evaluation.primary: AFTER all 3 policies have completed 32 charged actions and frozen all 64 lookup/learned predictions, evaluator chooses 16 FUTURE tasks x among ALL 64, ranked SHA256('WSP141|FUTURE|'+str(private_seed)+'|'+str(x)) independent of chosen action sets. Same16 source tasks for all policies, WITHOUT dropping any because observed. Model's observation history not given future key.
evaluation.distinguish: For every arm/family report task responses split into SEEN (source memory lookup) and UNSEEN (genuine model prediction) with distinct denominators and correctness. Headline gain is unconditional future TASK utility, not unseen-only causal generalization.
evaluation.secondary: Evaluate all64 source effects for error diagnostics, and common-unobserved predictions as explicitly conditional descriptive controls, not a primary gate; never call known-observation recall a newly discovered relationship
evaluation.outcomes: 8 known worlds, 8 unfamiliar majority, 8 switch, 4 off, 4 cold relabel, 16 future task requests/world. Paired responses across policies but only 8 independent world replicates/family.
evaluation.retention: After later worlds, 64 readouts on each prior KNOWN world unchanged. For each policy exact saved public action/effect states recompute identical full readouts; four new source-free same-law opaque-ID relabels 64 outputs each should be identical 256/256; separately score correctness, no source actions.

frozen_rules.status: DEVELOPMENT_RANDOM_CONTROL_FUTURE_UTILITY_SUPPORTED only if the unfamiliar AND switch independent future-query gains against the BETTER fixed/random each >=5pp, known noninferiority, unseen error thresholds, source custody, symbolic equality, cold relabel & retention all PASS; else DEVELOPMENT_RANDOM_CONTROL_FUTURE_UTILITY_NO_GO
frozen_rules.if_no_go: Preserve original result, do not retune old cohort or pretend information/science gain; no negative outcome erasure

research_limits.small_sample: 8 independent synthetic worlds per positive family; 16 task queries per world not independent replications
research_limits.advantages: Unconditional future queries are independent of intervention sets; still same six-bit public input domain, pre-supplied generic structural template class and synthetic generator, not authentic novel relationship invention.
research_limits.efficiency: Report whole-process CPU/wall/tracemalloc; no energy qualification or per-arm speed inference from wall totals
research_limits.qualification: Original source-safe Ubuntu+Windows focused + G29 generated atlas for source SHA + mandatory full inherited source-pinned Ubuntu/Windows root/focused; all exact fingerprints
